analysis:
Examined the complete supplied base/head runbook, added executable metadata and requant.py patch. New behavior reconstructs model artifacts using remote indexes, safetensors ranges and a template manifest, with deterministic quantization/selftest digests. The runbook separates uploading from authenticated promotion and retains independent qualification, immutable revisions and cache-artifact allowlisting (T-012/T-027/T-041). No supplied change alters provider authorization, attestation, traffic encryption, billing or cache isolation directly. The remote-manifest filesystem write introduces a publication-tool trust boundary not described in the indexed canonical model.
Integration must examine .github/workflows/model-requant-upload.yml and its validation/upload helpers: docs/operations/model-revisions.md:191-214 asserts ref guards, environment approval and credential scoping; :255-283 asserts verification before writes and input validation. Those implementations are not supplied here. Verify downloaded-template validation, redirect/network restrictions, credential exposure during reconstruction, candidate hash enforcement and conditional immutable reservation. requant.py:38-55 reads HTTP responses without size bounds, and RemoteST trusts remote header lengths/offsets; assess runner resource limits in that integration scope. Selftest checks arithmetic/serialization reproducibility, not model provenance or inference quality. Missing workflow evidence leaves those security contracts unverified, not established regressions.

findings.detail: cmd_build takes file paths directly from the downloaded template manifest and passes them to os.path.join(a.out, p) without containment checks. A malicious template manifest can supply an absolute path or a path containing '..', causing copied bytes to overwrite files accessible to the invoking account outside the output directory. This occurs during reconstruction, before the runbook's downstream candidate-manifest verification, so that verification cannot undo the write. A compromised template host could consequently modify runner or local account files, potentially including executable files. Validate every downloaded manifest path before fetching or writing: reject absolute paths, traversal components and platform-specific separators, enforce output-root containment, and prevent symlink following. Validation of the separately supplied candidate manifest is not a substitute for validating this downloaded manifest.
findings.title: Remote template manifest can write outside the build directory
